Sarah / Dylan —

Attached is our suggested DPA redline (dpa-redline-solterra-20270412.docx) that attempts to align with Solterra’s retention asks while preserving our standard obligations. Summary of the main edits:
- Section 4.2 (Data retention): we accept 30 days for evaluation logs and 90 days for production telemetry by default; we added a clause for customer-requested extended retention subject to additional fees and SOC scope adjustments.
- Section 6 (Security assurance): clarified that we will provide SOC 2 Type I report for the evaluation period and a SOC 2 Type II within 6 months of go-live or upon renewal (we can discuss an accelerated Type II as part of an enterprise contract).
- Section 9 (Subprocessors): added a carveout for optional cloud region replication; requires prior notice and SOC-equivalent assurances.

I flagged a few optional deletions that would speed sign (inline comments). If Solterra is comfortable with the evaluation-window SOC 2 Type I + evidence package, we can commit to the May 7 DPA sign target.

—Kimberly Park
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
